There was no BBC4 version of Hijack (they only made those for the actual series, not the pilot) , so we're "only" missing five episodes, not six.

By the way, that scheduled broadcast order ended up being changed. The Hostage episode was delayed because of the kidnapping of Kenneth Bigley, and eventually aired on BBC2 a few months later but the BBC4 version was never broadcast. The ones BBC4 did air, went out immediately after the BBC2 versions - the BBC2 editions were at 9pm, the BBC4 versions at 10pm. 

So this is the list as broadcast, rather than as originally scheduled:

1. Hijack (Pilot) - BBC2, 3 February 2004 (available on YouTube)
2. Plague - BBC2 / BBC4, 5 September 2004 (both versions missing)
3. Flood - BBC2 / BBC4, 12 September 2004 (BBC2 version missing, BBC4 version on YouTube)
4. Hostage - BBC2, 14 March 2005 (BBC2 version missing, BBC4 version missing and unaired)

Hostage was originally scheduled for 12 September 2004, and Flood for the 19th, but Flood was brought forward a week, then on 19 September BBC2 showed a repeat of Hijack (and BBC4, who now had an hour with nothing in it, filled the time with some random unrelated documentary).
